description: The live market read for an event: per event, the fee-inclusive marketplace get-in price and whether fans are currently selling into it (how many open listings). Reach for this, not search_events, whenever price is the question or the user might make an offer rather than pay the asking price (e.g. 'tickets to the season opener', 'cheap seats near me'). It tells you an event has open fan listings worth an offer; for the listings themselves use list_open_listings. For plain discovery with no price read -- just finding the event, performer, or venue -- use search_events instead. Do not use for scores, news, or standings.

cbsa.description: Metro area filter (synonyms: city, near me, area).

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

max_date.description: Filter events on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). For relative phrases like 'next month', resolve against _meta.context.today.

min_date.description: Filter events on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). For relative phrases like 'this weekend', resolve against _meta.context.today.
